message.content:
This is a distilled palm fatty acid, which falls under heading 3823 (industrial monocarboxylic fatty acids; acid oils from refining). Within that heading, 3823.19 covers other industrial monocarboxylic fatty acids, which includes distilled fatty acids. Palm fatty acid distillate would go in 3823.19.20 (distilled fatty acids) or a similar subheading.

The HTSUS structure for 3823 is as follows:
- 3823.11.00 Stearic acid
- 3823.12.00 Oleic acid
- 3823.13.00 Tall oil fatty acids
- 3823.19 Other: 3823.19.10 Distilled fatty acids; 3823.19.20 Fatty acid distillates; 3823.19.90 Other
- 3823.70 Industrial fatty alcohols

Two points favor distilled fatty acids. The product is described as a distilled palm fatty acid. It is also used as an animal feed supplement, but the fatty acids themselves are not a preparation of the type in 2309. CBP rulings on similar calcium-salt products were classified in 2309, whereas free fatty acid prills were classified in 3823.

I am recalling the statistical suffixes from memory: 3823.19.2000 is "Distilled fatty acids" and 3823.19.4000 is "Other". I am fairly sure about 3823.19.20 as the distilled fatty acids line, so I will use it with the 00 suffix.

```json
{"hts_code": "3823.19.2000", "reason": "Distilled palm fatty acid in prill form is an industrial monocarboxylic fatty acid, classified as distilled fatty acids under heading 3823."}
```
